title: Club Champs 2016
text:
Our new Club Champion, Martin Hore, was presented with the Suffolk Punch Bowl at our Kings Forest West event last Sunday. The Championships were held at WAOC's Mildenhall North event the previous weekend: Martin's pace was 2 seconds per kilometre faster than Louise's over the whole course and Barney achieved third place overall. Full results, together with an explanation of the calculations involved, can be viewed here.

(Thanks to Sally Wilkinson for the photograph)
